Details

This is a list of the individuals who currently have pre-release access to MOD’s key Official and Accredited Official Statistics. The list includes the titles of the documents which those individuals currently have pre-release access to. This document will be updated as lists are revised, or pre-release access is removed altogether. Publications not included in the lists do not have pre-release access.

Previous pre-release lists can be found in the UK Government Web Archive.
